systematic_error_summary.e_to_d_analysis: In 38 out of 126 held-out class E records (30.16%), the model predicted Class D (expected_admin). 36 of these 38 errors share the exact same closing sentence: "The engagement record and target owner independently verify prior permission, timing and completion within scope." In the training set, class D heavily relied on phrases like "Operations audit verified the prior approval, allowed window and successful completion within the requested scope." Without exposure to this validation-job template during training, the model conflated security authorization with operational change authorization.
systematic_error_summary.other_errors_analysis: The remaining 11 errors consist of 1 C->B (ransomware-like encryption telemetry overpowering the benign verification clause) and 10 G->B (unresolved source contradictions on high-impact actions triggering a cautious suspicious classification).
